title: Personal Training Packages: the active-status gate on logging a late cancellation
content:
## Scope
This document covers the Personal Training Packages product line and states the status basis on which a late cancellation may be logged against a package.

## Rule
A late cancellation may be logged against a package only while that package's own status is active, on the same footing as a session redemption. A package whose status is paused, exhausted, expired, or closed may not have a further late cancellation logged against it.

## Points of judgement
- If the package's status reads active at the moment the late cancellation is being logged, it may be logged against that package.
- If the package's status reads paused, exhausted, expired, or closed at that moment, the late cancellation may not be logged against that package.
This gate looks only at the status of the specific package the late cancellation names; a member's other open packages, whatever their own status, play no part in this determination.
